title: Prove the exact unequal-pivot Schur dimension law (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with finite corroboration. For commuting field idempotents with distinct nonzero scalar leading entries p,q and prescribed leading product h, the exact least ambient dimension attaining Schur-commutator rank two is

```text
N(p,q,h) = 3 + [h in {0,p,q}] + [1-p-q+h != 0].
```

Every minimum is attained. Over F3, p=1,q=2 gives dimensions five, five and four at h=0,1,2. Over F5, p=2,q=3,h=4 gives dimension three.

This answers Open next question 1 of #4771, head `22cb0bda57237d39d0e6944b232447d3a2809311`. Its equal-pivot theorem is cited rather than audited. The new unequal-pivot case needs one two-dimensional zero-product sector at each endpoint, while the predecessor p=q=h case needs two. The formula includes a lower bound and an explicit attaining construction over every field.

Only `research/unequal-pivot-schur-dimension/` is added. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Nick Petalas #4771/#4746/#4278/#4597, ssafwann #4671/#4657, Ryanson Jonathan #4609/#4617, lee-phys #4634, and the retained BIT/header lineage detailed in the package. The finite-field and matrix helpers are adapted from #4771 with exact source provenance; no predecessor executable is invoked at runtime. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19131498). The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side question. Base is canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7.

## Evidence

Before: #4771 explicitly leaves unequal pivots open. After: PROOF.md classifies the three active sector directions, gives the exact zero-product dimension charges, and constructs attaining matrices.

- All **1,140** parameter triples over F3,F4,F5,F7,F8,F9 pass literal checks of idempotence, commutation, prescribed pivots/product, direct Schur multiplication, commutator rank and the scalar factorization.
- A separate exact optimization enumerates **14,270** scalar vector pairs and **3,528** sector-map patterns. Every minimum agrees. Dimensions zero, one and two realize every scalar-map zero/nonzero type; this is not an ambient-matrix truncation.
- **Eight rejection controls** cover three missing required endpoint sectors, invalid zero/equal pivots, an invalid product, a nonfield order and a mutated projector. The checks remain enabled under optimized Python.
- Both registered commands pass on CPython 3.12.15. Measured local durations are **0.113 seconds ordinary** and **0.115 seconds optimized**, against separate 60-second timeouts. These are check durations, not speed comparisons.
- Package metadata/replay, six-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, export integrity, and an optimized read-only Git-free export replay pass on `a012548529a25a103345e8e8a8afa707a2b3a3e6`. All seven exported files, including the export receipt, remain unchanged.
- Syntax/function-capacity inspection passes; the longest function has 33 lines. Both registered commands use warnings as errors. The bounded CPython allocation deviation is documented. No external static analyzer is installed or claimed.
- The selected source-binding orientation passes after sparse inputs are materialized. This is metadata orientation, not a selected scientific replay.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim rests on the written algebraic proof, with finite corroboration. It covers one-coordinate deletion, commuting field idempotents, and distinct nonzero pivots. Larger prescribed matrix products, coefficient rings and later elimination states are outside scope. Header production/frequency, physical caller, restoration, precision, stock and the complete consumer bill remain unknown. No supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem follows.

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and selected scientific cold replay were not run. Every registered local check ran.

## Related open work

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22 19:43:47 UTC were refreshed before DONE. The five other newly opened PRs were read for overlap.

- #4777 studies three orthogonal corank-one requests over F2 and a full-guard probability inequality. F2 has only one nonzero scalar, so it has no parameter pair with p!=q in this theorem; there is no overlapping numerical minimum to compare.
- #4778 studies all-field full-guard correlation for one-way coupled, noncommuting requests. This theorem assumes commuting idempotents and computes minimum dimension, so the input domains and numerical quantities are disjoint.

The other new account PRs #4776, #4780 and #4781 study right-vector target reachability or factor counts over coefficient algebras; they do not assert this Schur dimension or an overlapping numerical minimum. The merged predecessor #4771 fixes equal pivots, also a disjoint parameter domain. Its equal-pivot theorem and explicit unequal-pivot open question retain their credit.

At initial publication no same-object open PR appeared in the live Schur title/body search. Canonical-main README and merged-PR searches were refreshed before committing. Sparse local notes, unpublished work and arbitrary code diffs remain outside the completeness claim; TASK.json records that earlier coverage and exact source pins.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the least dimension for unequal scalar block pivots pI_d,qI_d and prescribed product H, beginning with a nondiagonal 2-by-2 H. Scalar nonvanishing no longer determines sector-map ranks.
2. Count complete headers for a prescribed unequal-pivot profile, beginning with F3 p=1,q=2,h=2 after specifying the weighted header ensemble. Existence alone gives neither frequency nor a paid producer.

The registered replay runs both ordinary and optimized verification commands. All registered local checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight and Git-free export replay also passed. This records execution of the scoped package checks, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the universal theorem.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. This isolated research addition changes no shared implementation, frozen evidence or selected-frontier file.
